ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: On the left side of the figure is the land-price curve of the same area in different periods; the vertical axis represents land price, and the horizontal axis roughly represents the change in distance from the city center outward to the urban area, suburbs, and other directions. 下图为我国某市同一地区不同时期地价曲线图。

<image1>

根据该地区地价的变化，甲处可能会出现什么类型的住宅区？

The 1985 land-price curve generally declines as it gets farther away from the city center; the 2005 land-price curve shows obvious fluctuations in the overall change, among which the position marked “Jia” is located near the suburbs, and the 2005 land price forms a local peak at Jia. Then reason: Jia is not part of the central commercial core area of the city center, but the land price is relatively high, indicating that this place may be attractive to high-income groups because of improvements in transportation, environment, or location conditions. According to the laws of urban land rent and residential area differentiation, areas near the suburbs with relatively high land prices and better environmental conditions are likely to form high-grade residential areas.
